data.title: WAMY Commends Saudi Arabia's Efforts in Child Care, Protection, and Empowerment on World Children's Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Marking World Children's Day, observed annually on November 20, the World Assembly of Muslim Youth (WAMY) has commended the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's efforts in caring for children and protecting their rights by advancing education and healthcare services, strengthening social protection programs, and providing a safe environment that fosters their growth and capabilities.
    The assembly noted that its own global initiatives in this field include sponsoring orphans, supporting children's education, establishing schools and educational facilities, and providing healthcare and humanitarian aid across various countries.
    WAMY affirmed its commitment to continuing its child-focused programs—emphasizing access to education, healthcare, and skills development—while lauding the Kingdom's initiatives to support childhood and empower future generations in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
